plainText:
Welcome to Blueberry Academy! (Japanese: テラ☆キラ！ブルーベリー学園 Tera☆Sparkle! Blueberry Academy) is the 115th episode of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, and the 1,347th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on October 31, 2025, and is scheduled to air in the United Kingdom on May 25, 2026 .
 
 
 

==Plot==
The episode begins with someone's and attacking with in a Double Battle against and . The of the latter Pokémon, Ann, has her Pokémon counter with . Minun uses to power up Plusle's , allowing the attack to bind Samurott and Sandslash together. Sandslash quickly breaks the bind with , and the Trainer of both , Lacey, compliments Ann for being able to utilize what she has learned at Blueberry Academy. Ann has Samurott use , but both Plusle and Minun negate with , which triggers their respective , and , in the process. Ann is left in awe at Lacey's skills, with getting excited from the audience seats. The school's director, Cyrano, joins her and the two discuss Ann's presence as an exchange student. Meanwhile, the Brave Olivine approaches Blueberry Academy and the younger members of the Rising Volt Tacklers are in awe of the school.

They leave the airship with the older members of the group and are greeted by Cyrano at the gate. While bringing them to Briar, he allows the group to train at the school and even arranges their accommodation. However, Briar completely forgets about their arrival and asks the group to meet at her office tomorrow instead. While pondering what to do with their newfound free time, Dot asks Cyrano about how the school came to be in the middle of the ocean. The school's director is saved from answering by Lacey, who exchanges introductions with the Rising Volt Tacklers. Cyrano tasks Lacey with giving the school's visitors a tour, and she reluctantly accepts, knowing how he can't be trusted with giving tours due to his forgetful nature. Lacey brings the group to the Terarium, where they are amazed to see a man-made environment that is split into four different areas — the Savanna Biome, Coastal Biome, Canyon Biome, and Polar Biome — which allow Pokémon to thrive anywhere. While Ult chases after the distracted , the others spot a stallized , which Lacey explains is due to the Terarium Core resting above them. Having briefly heard from Briar about doing maintenance on this, Lacey reveals Terastal energy coming out from the core is what allows the wild Pokémon to Terastallize. Lacey then brings the group to the Central Plaza where they reunite with Ann and Nemona. Nemona happily reveals she came to Blueberry Academy with Penny, who is elsewhere at the moment, before challenging Roy to a Double Battle of their own. While Roy brings out and like last time, Nemona calls out and , having caught the latter as a after arriving at the school. Lacey confirms the will end once someone has two knocked out Pokémon and begins the battle.

Decidueye avoids a from Crocalor by jumping into the air before entering a portal with . Upon exiting, Decidueye tries to attack Lucario, but it avoids the Arrow Quill Pokémon. Lucario manages to block a follow-up attack from Pawmot, resulting in Nemona getting her Pokémon to react defensively, with the Hands-On Pokémon using . While it is underground, Roy calls for Crocalor and Lucario to focus their attacks on Decidueye, who is in the air. Lucario and Decidueye take on each other as Pawmot comes up from the ground, only for it to accidentally attack its ally when Lucario holds it in place from behind. While Crocalor attacks Pawmot, Lucario was forced to stop its attack midway when it gets stuck in place as a result of its shadow getting struck by from Decidueye. Lucario is unable to escape the effect of the arrow and gets defeated by Nemona's Pokémon, leaving Roy with only Crocalor. To add on to Nemona's advantage, Pawmot is now a pure Pokémon thanks to , which removes the user's type, reducing the effectiveness of Crocalor's . However, Roy isn't fazed by this setback and Terastallizes Crocalor, with Nemona doing the same with Pawmot. Crocalor presses forward with to stop Pawmot before it finishes charging its power but gets caught in Decidueye's Spirit Shackle. Crocalor musters up the strength to escape Decidueye's Spirit Shackle, but it's too late and Pawmot's enhanced finishes off Crocalor, making Nemona the winner of the Double Battle.

Afterwards, the group compliments Roy and Nemona's battle before Ult, who joined the spectators earlier, asks Nemona for a battle. Unfortunately, Lacey reminds Nemona about her return to Paldea, leaving Ult frustrated by another missed opportunity to battle. After Nemona leaves, the visiting Rising Volt Tacklers express their desire to grow stronger as Trainers. Ann suggests having the other s help, such as Lacey, who happens to be part of the . Just then, she is joined by a fellow Elite Four member, Drayton, whom she asks to help her. Despite the visitors also asking him to help, he casually turns them down, getting into an argument with Lacey. Nonetheless, Liko, Roy, Dot, and Ult begin their training at Blueberry Academy.

==Major events==
 
The Rising Volt Tacklers arrive in Unova, with Liko, Roy, Dot, and Ult visiting the region for the first time.
Liko, Roy, Dot, and Ult arrive at Blueberry Academy, where they meet Director Cyrano and members Drayton and Lacey for the first time.
Liko, Roy, and Dot meet Ann again, while Ult meets her for the first time.
Liko, Roy, Dot, and Ult meet again.
Nemona is revealed to own a .
Roy has a Double Battle against Nemona and loses.

==Trivia==
Mega Nidothing's Mega Mega! Mega Evolution: 
This is the first episode of the Rising Again arc.
Iolite replaces GET BACK as the Japanese opening theme while Asleep or Awake replaces YUU as the Japanese ending theme.
Despite the Ability having existed since Generation III, this episode marks the first time that has been activated in the .
The first eyecatch features Roy with his , , , and Captain Pikachu, and the second features with her and .
For the initial airing of this episode, the Mega Nidothing's Mega Mega! Mega Evolution segment was replaced by a trailer for a present campaign.
Dot, , Ult, his , Roy, Crocalor, Liko, , and Drayton narrate the preview for the next episode.
